phases.name: Freeze the smaller contract and prove access
Build the shell and trusted household boundary
Capture, confirm and maintain kitchen observations
Prove real assistance, managed context and typed actions
Complete share, shopping and recorded outcomes
Prove the full flow and prepare a reviewable release

units.title: Reconcile scope, source conflicts and screen authority
units.acceptance: Owner review cites current Stitch map, exclusions and supersession; no unresolved contradictory active scope.

units.title: Define the first complete dinner-change slice
units.acceptance: Annotated Home→capture→confirm→Ask→approve→outcome journey includes all error/empty/conflict states.

units.title: Freeze schemas and mutation semantics
units.acceptance: Reviewed candidate/date/unit/proposal/card contracts include unknowns, versions and idempotency.

units.title: Validate managed runtime, Sessions, Memory Bank and Gemini access
units.acceptance: Recorded project/region/IAM/quota and actual service response; explicit blocker ADR if fallback needed.

units.title: Set privacy, consent, retention and cost boundaries
units.acceptance: Chosen retention durations, scoped preference consent/deletion policy and per-user cost limits documented; available credits are verified or recorded as unknown, the billing account's linked-project impact is reviewed, and a $10/month alert is configured for the single hackathon project before paid services are enabled. Its non-cap behavior and additional cost controls are explicit.

units.title: Review M0 exit evidence
units.acceptance: Scope, schemas and access proof reviewed; no implementation dependency rests on an unverified service claim.

units.title: Establish solo household identity and membership
units.acceptance: Valid identity resolves explicit membership; absent/foreign membership denied without default tenant.

units.title: Implement versioned facts and idempotent command boundary
units.acceptance: Transaction checks base version and request hash; duplicate retry has one effect, changed payload conflicts.

units.title: Constrain media and direct data access
units.acceptance: Private signed upload/read, bounded file validation, canonical client-write denial and retention handling demonstrated.

units.title: Establish shared tokenized UI foundation and four-tab responsive shell
units.acceptance: Reusable Button/Heading/Input/Card primitives are in frontend/src/components/ui/; shared shell/navigation is in frontend/src/components/layout/; Tailwind v4 semantic tokens are centralized in frontend/src/app/globals.css @theme; Home/Kitchen/Ask/Shop reuse them and match the light Stitch references at 360px and wider breakpoints, with accessible touch/focus behavior.

units.title: Provide honest empty, loading, error and demo states
units.acceptance: Synthetic demo is visibly isolated; errors preserve drafts and unknown integrations are not labeled connected.

units.title: Review M1 exit evidence
units.acceptance: Shell review plus authenticated cross-scope denial and conflict/retry evidence available.

units.title: Add manual and text intake with candidate-only persistence
units.acceptance: Unconfirmed entries cannot change canonical Kitchen; bounds and cancel/retry work.

units.title: Connect real structured photo extraction
units.acceptance: Real model response validates candidate schema; injection text is ignored as instructions; manual fallback works.

units.title: Implement correction and explicit confirmation sheet
units.acceptance: User edits names/amount/date type; one confirmation writes selected facts once and reports conflict safely.

units.title: Implement Kitchen observation editing and uncertainty
units.acceptance: Unknown/stale stock is visible; incompatible units and negative quantities rejected; confirmed dates retain type/source.

units.title: Add truthful Home/use-soon prompts
units.acceptance: Confirmed date reminders differ from last-checked prompts; no photo-derived safety/expiry assertion.

units.title: Review M2 exit evidence
units.acceptance: Capture correction→confirm→Kitchen persists; no mutation before consent, retries/conflicts and missing fields covered.

units.title: Connect one real ADK orchestrator and scoped managed Sessions
units.acceptance: Recorded actual Gemini/ADK tool trace with owned managed session IDs; foreign session lookup denied.

units.title: Implement approved-preference memory write and controls
units.acceptance: Only consented preference event reaches managed Memory Bank; view/edit/revoke/delete states exposed without raw transcripts.

units.title: Prove recall across two sessions and memory isolation
units.acceptance: Two distinct sessions recall approved preference; second user cannot; revoke excludes it immediately and provider deletion verified.

units.title: Render the five validated card types
units.acceptance: Discriminated schemas/components handle invalid card fallback; no arbitrary markup/endpoints or hidden writes.

units.title: Implement dinner adjustment and explicit proposal approval
units.acceptance: 4→2 scaling deterministic; prepared-stage behavior sensible; stale/expired/malicious approvals denied; no inferred consumption.

units.title: Review M3 exit evidence
units.acceptance: Real agent+memory proof and card approval transaction demonstrated; local substitutes cannot satisfy managed-service gate.

units.title: Record used, stored, discarded and compost observations
units.acceptance: Known compatible quantity updates once; unknown remains unknown; compost route is user-observed/local-policy-aware.

units.title: Implement share-before-waste sheet and handover states
units.acceptance: Owner-private handover log needs no second account; owner-reported offer/accept/handover/cancel states distinct; community interest simulated; prohibited recipient routes blocked.

units.title: Implement Shop list, stock check and permitted handoff
units.acceptance: Stale stock prompts confirmation; list edits approved; external link never claims purchase/live price/account sync.

units.title: Implement recorded activity with measurement basis
units.acceptance: Measured/estimated/unknown shown; duplicates/reversals excluded; no invented savings or undefined ratios.

units.title: Connect Home and Ask to outcome follow-up
units.acceptance: Plan acceptance differs from actual use; user can return and record/correct outcome without losing context.

units.title: Review M4 exit evidence
units.acceptance: Ten Stitch states covered through four destinations/shared flows; sharing/shopping/activity claims remain truthful.

units.title: Verify end-to-end household loop and mobile usability
units.acceptance: Real capture→confirm→Ask→approved adjustment→recorded outcome across deployed boundaries; screenshots and latency sample recorded.

units.title: Verify hostile, concurrent and unavailable-service cases
units.acceptance: Foreign scope/session, injected intake, malformed cards, retries/conflicts, no model/memory/network covered with actual outcomes.

units.title: Measure token, latency, cost and privacy behavior
units.acceptance: Bounded representative sample names model/device/network; redacted trace and retention/deletion audit; no fabricated score.

units.title: Automate authorized hackathon deployment with rollback
units.acceptance: Reviewed single project/region, budget alerts and additional cost controls, IAM, Secret Manager references and rollback; repeatable Google Cloud build/deploy pipeline rolls out to the one hackathon environment; deployed version has HTTPS and health evidence before deployed E2E. Do not embed credentials in GitHub or repository files; if authorization/access unavailable, deployed gate stays blocked.

units.title: Record three-minute demo and operational handoff
units.acceptance: Shows real versus simulated labels, two-session preference, before/after facts and evidence links; remaining gaps explicit.

units.title: Review release gate and resolve open blockers
units.acceptance: All prerequisite evidence reviewed; only then mark hackathon-ready. No autonomous rollout or invented completion.
